/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { chromium } from '/tmp/app-router-browser-check/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs'
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] })
const page = await browser.newPage()
const errors = []
page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message))
try {
  await page.goto('http://localhost:3000/')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Welcome to My Blog' }).waitFor()
  await page.evaluate(() => { window.migrationNavigationSentinel = true })
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'View All Posts' }).click()
  await page.waitForURL('**/blog')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'All Blog Posts' }).waitFor()
  assert.equal(await page.title(), 'Blog - My Blog')
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.post-card').count(), 100)
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.migrationNavigationSentinel), true)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Read More' }).first().click()
  await page.waitForURL('**/blog/1')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Comments (5)' }).waitFor()
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.comment').count(), 5)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '← Back' }).click()
  await page.waitForURL('**/blog')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'All Blog Posts' }).waitFor()
  console.log('Client navigation, post comments, and router.back() passed without full reloads.')
  for (const path of ['/missing-route', '/blog/999999', '/blog/invalid']) {
    const response = await page.goto('http://localhost:3000' + path)
    assert.equal(response.status(), 404)
    await page.getByRole('heading', { name: '404 - Page Not Found' }).waitFor()
    assert.equal(await page.title(), '404 - Page Not Found')
    assert.equal(await page.locator('html').getAttribute('lang'), 'en')
    assert.equal(await page.locator('header').count(), 1)
    assert.equal(await page.locator('footer').count(), 1)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Go Back Home' }).click()
    await page.waitForURL('http://localhost:3000/')
    await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Welcome to My Blog' }).waitFor()
    console.log(path, 'custom 404, shared layout, metadata, and home navigation passed.')
  }
  assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
  console.log('No browser runtime errors.')
} finally {
  await browser.close()
}

import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { writeFileSync, unlinkSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import { chromium } from 'playwright'
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] })
const page = await browser.newPage()
const errors = []
page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message))
try {
  await page.goto('http://localhost:3000/')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Welcome to My Blog' }).waitFor()
  await page.evaluate(() => { window.migrationNavigationSentinel = true })
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'View All Posts' }).click()
  await page.waitForURL('**/blog')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'All Blog Posts' }).waitFor()
  assert.equal(await page.title(), 'Blog - My Blog')
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.post-card').count(), 100)
  assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.migrationNavigationSentinel), true)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Read More' }).first().click()
  await page.waitForURL('**/blog/1')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Comments (5)' }).waitFor()
  assert.equal(await page.locator('.comment').count(), 5)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '← Back' }).click()
  await page.waitForURL('**/blog')
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'All Blog Posts' }).waitFor()
  console.log('Client navigation, post comments, and router.back() passed without full reloads.')
  for (const path of ['/missing-route', '/blog/999999', '/blog/invalid']) {
    const response = await page.goto('http://localhost:3000' + path)
    assert.equal(response.status(), 404)
    await page.getByRole('heading', { name: '404 - Page Not Found' }).waitFor()
    assert.equal(await page.title(), '404 - Page Not Found')
    assert.equal(await page.locator('html').getAttribute('lang'), 'en')
    assert.equal(await page.locator('header').count(), 1)
    assert.equal(await page.locator('footer').count(), 1)
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Go Back Home' }).click()
    await page.waitForURL('http://localhost:3000/')
    await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Welcome to My Blog' }).waitFor()
    console.log(path, 'custom 404, shared layout, metadata, and home navigation passed.')
  }
  assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
  console.log('No browser runtime errors during navigation and 404 checks.')
  writeFileSync('/tmp/app-router-upstream-failure', '')
  const failedResponse = await page.goto('http://localhost:3001/')
  assert.equal(failedResponse.status(), 500)
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'An error occurred' }).waitFor()
  assert.equal(await page.title(), 'Error - My Blog')
  unlinkSync('/tmp/app-router-upstream-failure')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Try again' }).click()
  await page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Welcome to My Blog' }).waitFor()
  assert.equal(await page.title(), 'Home - My Blog')
  console.log('Error boundary and retry() recovered after a simulated upstream outage.')
} finally {
  if (existsSync('/tmp/app-router-upstream-failure')) unlinkSync('/tmp/app-router-upstream-failure')
  await browser.close()
}
JS
